response.original_title: Invisible Symphony - CicLAvia : Heart of Los Angeles
response.overview: Chronicles the inner workings of CicLAvia, a LA based non-profit, as they work to produce car free days across communities. Leading up to one of their largest events, the film reveals the poetic connection between the city and its people.
